title: Pro3 release remediation: docs cleanup, reproduction blockers, evidence hygiene
body: Source: priAlcOxidationML-final-release/docs/整改清单-修订版-2026-10-24.md (untracked, authored 2026-10-24). Scope: step 0 release cleanup (delete 18 internal docs per user ruling 2; README under-review claim removal), step 1 reproduction blockers (matplotlib get_cmap at src/explainer.py:286,429,566,773; savefig after plt.close at src/explainer.py:450-455,798-803; analysis/02 unpack mismatch against src/performance_scatter.py:286; path dual-track with no Path(__file__) anchoring; bare except at evaluator.py:116, explainer.py:350,630,1084 while keeping global warnings suppression), step 2 locked-environment rerun, step 3 evidence hygiene (46 blank PDFs, 05/06 CSV roles, heatmap filename mismatch, captions, JPG->PNG), step 4 release packaging. Out of scope: manuscript writing and research-layer work. Constraints: do not modify pro3 in this demo; two docs are untracked in-flight work by another agent; no GitHub Issue or PR was verified (API 404, gh unavailable); local Python lacks rdkit and shap, so no model or SHAP rerun is possible here.
